name: "AgentShield Bench v3" — does not exist
description: A named security benchmark with a version number that cannot be found anywhere.
descriptionZh: 一个带版本号的安全基准名称，在任何地方都查不到。
credibility: No benchmark called AgentShield Bench, in v3 or any other version, could be located. The name collides with two unrelated things: AgentShield, a scanner that audits Claude Code configurations (not a benchmark), and AgentShield-G, a paper on graph-structured guardrail models. Real agent security benchmarks that do exist include Agent Security Bench (ICLR 2025) and AgentSecBench — different names, different authors.
credibilityZh: 查不到任何名为 AgentShield Bench（无论 v3 还是其他版本）的基准。该名称与两件无关事物撞名：AgentShield（审计 Claude Code 配置的扫描器，不是基准）与 AgentShield-G（图结构护栏模型论文）。真实存在的 Agent 安全基准包括 Agent Security Bench（ICLR 2025）与 AgentSecBench——名称与作者都不同。
sourceName: Correction: the actual AgentShield is a config scanner
keyFact: As of October 2026 no benchmark named AgentShield Bench v3 could be found; the closest real security benchmarks for agents are Agent Security Bench (ICLR 2025) and AgentSecBench.
keyFactZh: 截至 2026 年 10 月，查不到任何名为 AgentShield Bench v3 的基准；真实存在的 Agent 安全基准是 Agent Security Bench（ICLR 2025）与 AgentSecBench。
debunks: The claim that a benchmark called AgentShield Bench v3 evaluates agent goal integrity, goal-hijacking resistance and autonomous threat resistance.
debunksZh: 「一个名为 AgentShield Bench v3 的基准用于评估 Agent 目标完整性、目标劫持抵抗力与自主威胁抵抗能力」这一说法。
